class.name: CASLayout
class.brief_description: Describes how a file is split into chunks in GCAS packages.
class.description: A layout is returned by a [CASLayoutProvider] to control how a file is stored in GCAS packages. Files are split into chunks that are compressed independently, so reading any part of a file only requires decompressing the chunks it overlaps. Layouts make the data read together at runtime (for example a texture mipmap or a mesh LOD) map to whole chunks. All offsets are in bytes from the start of the file.

method.name: add_cut
method.description: Forces a chunk boundary at [param offset].

method.name: add_group
method.description: Stores the range starting at [param offset] in a single chunk (for example data that is always read at once).

method.name: add_paged_range
method.description: Splits the range starting at [param offset] into chunks of [param page_size] bytes (for example virtual texture tiles).

method.name: set_range_codec
method.description: Stores the chunks of the range starting at [param offset] with [param codec]. For [constant CODEC_ZSTD], [param level] overrides the compression level if it isn't [code]0[/code].

method.name: set_range_priority
method.description: Overrides the placement priority of the chunks of the range starting at [param offset] (see [member priority]).

members.member: Data stored in the package with the file, which runtime code can read to locate parts of the file (for example the range of each mipmap of a streamed texture).
Placement priority of the file's chunks. Chunks are placed in ascending priority order, so data read early can be placed together at the start of the package.

constants.constant: Use the packer's default (Zstandard, unless the file type is known to be already compressed).
